article.title: The blinkers of bigotry
article.author: Editor
article.content: The current struggle of students and youth, though organized around specific and apparently limited objectives, like getting Gyanesh Kumar to resign as Chief Election Commissioner, is in reality against this entire social, political and economic counter-revolution that seeks to push the country back by centuries. The post The blinkers of bigotry appeared first on MR Online .
